units.title: 被动语态：把重点移到「被怎样」
units.thinking: 英语用被动不是为了翻译中文的「被」字，而是为了换焦点：当「谁做的」不重要、不知道、或不想说时，就把受事提到主语位置。中文说「这栋楼建于 1990 年」，英语说 The building was built in 1990 —— 重点是楼，不是建造者。抓住「换焦点」这个动机，被动就不再是死记的公式。

rules.formula: be + 过去分词（+ by 施事）
rules.desc: 时态体现在 be 上：is done / was done / has been done / will be done
happen / appear / belong 等不及物动词没有被动式

rules.formula: 常用场景：过程/规则/客观陈述
rules.desc: English is spoken here. / The work must be finished today.

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1990.
examples.zh: 这座桥建于 1990 年。（重点在桥）

examples.en: The bridge built in 1990.
examples.zh: ✗ 缺 be 动词

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 很多国家说英语。（规则性陈述用被动）

examples.en: It was happened yesterday.
examples.zh: ✗ happen 是不及物动词，没有被动

mistakes: 漏 be 动词，只留过去分词
给不及物动词加被动：was happened / is appeared ✗
be 与过去分词之间插错时态：The work is finished yesterday ✗（应为 was finished）

questions.q: The letter ___ yesterday.
questions.explain: yesterday 是过去时间，被动用 was + 过去分词。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
options: The accident was happened last night.
The accident is happened last night.
The accident was happen last night.
questions.explain: happen 不及物，用主动形式。

questions.q: English ___ all over the world.
questions.explain: 英语被说，用被动 is spoken。

questions.q: The homework must ___ before Friday.
questions.explain: 情态动词后的被动：must be + 过去分词。

questions.q: 「这栋楼是 1990 年建的」
questions.explain: 过去被动 was built。

questions.q: 被动语态的时态变化体现在哪个词上？
questions.explain: be 变动（is/was/has been/will be），过去分词不变。

units.title: 非谓语动词：一句话里只能有一个谓语
units.thinking: 英语有条铁律：一个句子只能有一个谓语动词。第二个动作怎么办？必须「降级」成非谓语形式——不定式（to do）、动名词（doing）、分词（doing/done）。选哪个，取决于它在句里扮演什么角色：目的/打算用不定式，作主语宾语用动名词，修饰名词用分词。理解「降级」这个逻辑，比背规则表有用得多。

rules.desc: I want to go. / He came to help.

rules.formula: doing：作主语/宾语，或表主动进行
rules.desc: Reading is fun. / I enjoy reading.

rules.formula: done：表被动完成，作定语/状语
rules.desc: a broken cup / Given more time, I could do it.

examples.en: I want to learn English.
examples.zh: 我想学英语。（打算用不定式）

examples.en: I want learn English.
examples.zh: ✗ want 后面必须接 to do

examples.en: Swimming is good for health.
examples.zh: 游泳有益健康。（动名词作主语）

examples.en: Swim is good for health.
examples.zh: ✗ 动词原形不能作主语

mistakes: 一个句子里出现两个谓语：I want go ✗ / I am want to go ✗
enjoy / finish / mind 后面用 to do（应为 doing）
分词逻辑主语不一致：Walking home, the rain started ✗（走路的不是雨）

questions.q: I enjoy ___ music.
questions.explain: enjoy 后面接动名词 doing。

questions.q: She came here ___ the truth.
questions.explain: 表目的用不定式 to do。

questions.q: ___ English well is not easy.
questions.explain: 动名词作主语。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
questions.explain: want + to do。

questions.q: The window ___ by Tom is broken.
questions.explain: 被打破的窗户：过去分词作定语表被动。

questions.q: 非谓语动词的出现原因是？
options: 一句话只能有一个谓语，其余动作要降级
questions.explain: 一个句子只有一个谓语，其他动词降级为非谓语。

units.title: 虚拟语气：与事实相反的假设
units.thinking: 虚拟语气的本质只有一句话：用「过去的形态」表达「不是真的」。所以说 If I were you（我现在不是你）、If I had known（当时并不知道）。中文用「要是…就好了 / 如果当时…」来表达，英语则统一用「退一步的时态」——理解了「退一步」，就不必背表格。

rules.formula: 与现在相反：If + 过去式，主句 would/could + 动词原形
rules.desc: If I were you, I would take it.

rules.formula: 与过去相反：If + had done，主句 would have done
rules.desc: If I had studied, I would have passed.

rules.formula: wish / as if 后同样「退一步」
rules.desc: I wish I were taller. / He talks as if he knew everything.

examples.en: If I were you, I would apologize.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会道歉。（现在不是）

examples.en: If I am you, I will apologize.
examples.zh: ✗ 与事实相反要用虚拟

examples.en: If I had known, I would have come.
examples.zh: 要是我早知道，我就来了。（当时不知道）

examples.en: I wish I am taller.
examples.zh: ✗ wish 后用过去式 were

mistakes: 与现在相反的假设里用 am/is/are 或 will
wish 后面忘「退一步」：I wish I can ✗ → I wish I could ✓
把虚拟语气与真实条件句混淆（真实条件用一般时态：If it rains, I will stay home.）

questions.q: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
questions.explain: 虚拟语气中 be 统一用 were。

questions.q: If I ___ harder, I would have passed.
questions.explain: 与过去相反：If + had done。

questions.q: I wish I ___ speak French.
questions.explain: wish 后用过去形式表达不可能/愿望。

questions.q: 哪句是真实条件句？
options: If I were rich, I would travel.
If it rains, I will stay home.
If I had time, I would help.
questions.explain: 真实可能发生的条件用一般现在时 + will。

questions.q: He talks as if he ___ everything.
questions.explain: as if + 虚拟，用过去式。

questions.q: 虚拟语气的核心逻辑是？
options: 用过去的形态表示与事实相反
questions.explain: 「退一步的时态」= 不是真的。

units.title: 倒装：为了强调而调换语序
units.thinking: 英语语序通常是主语在前，但当否定词、only 短语被提到句首时，必须把助动词提到主语前面——这就是倒装。它不是为了好看，而是英语「形式标记焦点」的习惯：把注意力引到前面那个成分上。中文靠「尤其/正是」这类词强调，英语靠换语序。

rules.formula: 否定词提前：Never / Hardly / Not only + 助动词 + 主语
rules.desc: Never have I seen such a thing.

rules.formula: only + 状语提前：Only then did I realize…
rules.desc: Only in this way can we succeed.

rules.formula: 虚拟条件句省略 if 时倒装：Were I you… / Had I known…
rules.desc: Had I known, I would have helped.

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
examples.zh: 我从没见过这么美的地方。

examples.en: Never I have seen such a beautiful place.
examples.zh: ✗ 否定词提前后要倒装

examples.en: Only then did I understand.
examples.zh: 只有到那时我才明白。

examples.en: Only then I understood.
examples.zh: ✗ only 状语提前需倒装

mistakes: 倒装时漏掉助动词：Never I saw ✗
把 only + 主语提前当成倒装（Only he knows. 不倒装，因为 only 修饰主语）

questions.q: Never ___ such a thing.
questions.explain: 否定词提前：助动词 have 提到主语前。

questions.q: Only in this way ___ improve your English.
questions.explain: only + 方式状语提前，主句倒装。

questions.q: ___ I known the truth, I would have told you.
questions.explain: 虚拟条件省略 if 时用 Had 提前。

questions.q: 哪句正确？
options: Hardly I had arrived when it rained.
Hardly had I arrived when it rained.
Hardly I arrived when it rained.
Hardly did I had arrived when it rained.
questions.explain: Hardly 提前需倒装：Hardly had I arrived…

questions.q: Only he ___ the answer.
questions.explain: only 修饰主语时不倒装，正常语序。

questions.q: 倒装的触发条件通常是？
options: 否定词或 only 状语被提到句首
句子是疑问句以外的所有情况
questions.explain: 否定词/only 状语提前是常见触发条件。

units.title: 主谓一致：谓语要跟着主语走
units.thinking: 英语要求谓语动词在人称和数上与主语一致，这是「形式必须标记」的又一次体现。难点不在简单句，而在主语变长时：True or false? 这类插入语、along with 这类伴随短语、以及集合名词（family/team）到底算单数还是复数。判断方法只有一条：找到真正的核心主语。

rules.formula: 核心主语的单复数决定谓语
rules.desc: The list of items is long.（主语是 list，不是 items）

rules.formula: along with / together with / as well as 不改变主语数
rules.desc: Tom, along with his friends, is coming.

rules.formula: 集合名词视为整体用单数（The team is winning）；强调成员用复数（The team are arguing）
rules.desc: 英式英语中后者更常见

examples.en: The number of students is increasing.
examples.zh: 学生人数在增加。（主语是 number）

examples.en: The number of students are increasing.
examples.zh: ✗ 主语是 the number，用 is

examples.en: Either you or he is right.
examples.zh: 要么你对，要么他对。（就近原则）

examples.en: Either you or he are right.
examples.zh: ✗ 就近原则取 he → is

mistakes: 被 of 短语误导：The list of items are… ✗
each / every / either / neither 作主语时用复数谓语 ✗
there be 后有几个名词时忘记就近原则

questions.q: The list of names ___ on the desk.
questions.explain: 主语是 the list（单数）。

questions.q: Tom, along with his parents, ___ coming.
questions.explain: along with 不改变主语数，主语是 Tom。

questions.q: Each of the students ___ a book.
questions.explain: each 作主语用单数。

questions.q: There ___ a pen and two books on the desk.
questions.explain: 就近原则：离 be 最近的是 a pen。

questions.q: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.explain: neither 作主语视为单数。

questions.q: 判断主谓一致的要点是？
options: 找到真正的核心主语（去掉修饰成分）
questions.explain: 先去掉 of 短语等修饰，找核心主语。
